title: PPO Clipped Surrogate Loss with Clip Diagnostics

blocks.text: PPO clips probability ratios only when an unclipped change would improve the sampled objective too far. The task is: Return Torch PPO clipped policy loss, clip fraction, and sampled k3 KL estimate. Treat old policy log probabilities and advantages as fixed targets.

The inputs are `new_logp`, `old_logp`, `advantages`, `epsilon`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.

What changes in the boundary case

A useful test changes one condition while holding the remaining inputs fixed. Compare the output shape, state transition, valid edges, selected tokens, or returned status. This isolates the reason for the change.
